ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark gray to black) pixels covering approximately 85% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated in linear streaks and distal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark mass across both lobes; high-contrast white linear streaks on the mid-left lobe; localized white clusters on the far distal tips; isolated circular white pixel spot on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge with frequent low-amplitude peaks; distal tips exhibit high-amplitude jagged irregularities due to biological protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary convex curvature on the outer trailing edges, transitioning to a slight concavity approaching the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of elevated, high-contrast circular pixel groups (barnacle colonies) located on the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel and intersecting light-colored linear marks (rake marks) visible on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant physical distortion of the distal tips due to heavy barnacle encrustation; extensive linear scarring across the left fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Single, isolated high-contrast white circular mark located in the lower-central region of the left lobe.
